notes: Covers C-9feab250 (configure a jupyter server via its config file, floor easy) independently of willow-bridge: the port is sourced from a rotated JSON deploy descriptor (/app/nb_deploy.json) with a validation ladder (int or decimal string, 1024..65535, else default 7741) instead of an environment variable, the deliverable filename and default port differ, and port_retries=0 is additionally required (file-content check). The verifier launches `jupyter server --config=...` per hidden case and requires the loopback bind plus a tokenless HTTP 200 from /api/status, so a missing/malformed config line fails either the content gate or a live bind. hidden_case_generalization/adversarial_inputs=2 from seven distinct descriptor scenarios (explicit int, numeric string, missing key, non-numeric, below-range, above-range, absent file); interaction_statefulness=1 from starting/stopping long-lived server processes and polling bind readiness.
